body:
Note: this issue was filed May 13, over a month before Google's June 18 consumer tier sunset — so the original problem is likely unrelated to that event.

With no follow-up from the reporter and a `question` label still active, there is not enough detail to confirm whether this was resolved.

**If you are still affected:** Google has since transitioned the consumer Gemini CLI to Antigravity CLI. Hermes now ships a native `google-antigravity` OAuth provider (PR #50454, merged June 21). Try upgrading and running `hermes auth` to set up the new provider — it uses a different OAuth client and endpoint, so issues specific to the old `google-gemini-cli` provider may not apply.

If you can still reproduce on the latest version with `google-antigravity`, please share the output of `hermes doctor` and the error from your chat session so we can investigate further.

<!-- hermes-sweeper:item=25055 -->
<!-- hermes-sweeper:verdict=close reason=cannot_reproduce confidence=high -->
Thanks for reporting this. This is an automated hermes-sweeper review.

- The reported `google-gemini-cli` OAuth provider was removed on current main in 7130d608 because Google actively bans third-party tools using that OAuth flow.
- The prior comment's interim `google-antigravity` suggestion is also no longer applicable: that OAuth inference provider was removed in the same change.
- Current supported Gemini setup is Google AI Studio with `GOOGLE_API_KEY` or `GEMINI_API_KEY` (`plugins/model-providers/gemini/__init__.py:51-59`; `website/docs/integrations/providers.md:42`).

Because the reported legacy provider is no longer present on current main, the original behavior cannot be reproduced. If an API-key or Vertex AI Gemini setup fails on a current release, please open a new report with `hermes doctor` output and the full chat error.
